acceptance_test_interpretation: M0-MANIFEST-INDEPENDENCE-01 is necessary because a generated deck and one self-consistent materializer cannot establish a frozen instrument; checker independence must include independently derived semantic invariants, not merely two parsers reproducing one digest. M0-CPU-CONFORMANCE-02 can establish exhaustive software conformance only, but it necessarily occurs after implementation and therefore conflicts with its required_before value. M0-VISIBILITY-NONINTERFERENCE-03 is the central shortcut gate: twin histories must collide byte-for-byte until an ordinary separating outcome, with divergence afterward restricted by the public taint DAG; the later M-TEXT protocol must repeat this check on fully rendered model-visible bytes, tokenizer outputs, tool returns, and session state. M0-PROVENANCE-INTERVENTION-04 correctly tests chronology, independent later support, root deduplication, aliases, cycles, revocation, and transform specificity, but deranged or shuffled connectivity must also be exposure-, degree-, lexical-, and answer-prior-matched before supporting a behavioral connectivity interpretation. M0-ROOT-REDUCER-05 correctly prevents pseudoreplication: roots are the maximum M-TEXT units, while goals, twins, paths, branches, calls, aliases, cuts, and reruns are repeated measures; engineering fixture multiplicity is not scientific N. M0-V7-REUSE-FIREWALL-06 appropriately treats V7 as reference mathematics only and requires a primitive-level mapping, hash verification, and oracle denial; V7's prior ratification and failed audit provide no PCFL authority. M0-MTEXT-HANDOFF-07 should freeze every outcome-changing semantic projection before model use, while renderer, tokenizer, prompt, parser, and session choices may remain only behind a separately exact and ratified boundary; changing any such choice must fork the assay. MTEXT-SUPPLIED-CAUSAL-08 is capable of testing bounded causal usefulness only if changed-goal traversal, experiment selection, delayed old-plus-new behavior, reset persistence, and adverse outcomes are separate noncompensatory endpoints. It cannot by itself establish DREAM authorship, a memory write, parametric transport, online learning, accumulation, or continued improvement. Its required_before value is also inconsistent because the evidence artifact is produced by model execution. MTEXT-BYPASS-TRACE-09 is essential: no-memory, target-only, answer-prior, raw-context, RAG, native-graph, and organized-memory controls must receive the same legal public evidence under explicitly reported resource factors. Masking and binding/twin substitution can establish behavioral dependence on memory content, but not equal memory cost across substrates. M0-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW-10 is a valid pre-model gate and must remain bound to exact implemented bytes; neither the reviewer nor the author-side advocate supplies scientific evidence or successor authorization.

assumptions: No interpretation for this change other than the proposal and listed durable context was read.
M0 roots and alias/order twins are exhaustive engineering fixtures, not automatically independent scientific samples.
M-TEXT uses one frozen model, so any supported behavioral claim is conditional on that model, assay, roots, and resource contract rather than a population of agents.
Authentic supplied links are constructed without access to later goals, answers, intervention labels, scores, or model outputs.
Offline world truth, expected answers, and intervention oracles are available only to checkers and reporting, never to carrier construction, retrieval, prompts, or actor commands.
Recurrence in M-TEXT means repeated goal-conditioned reading, acting, observing, and plan revision; it does not mean DREAM recurrence, parameter updates, or learning across lives.
Same semantic content across text and a later LoRA substrate does not imply fixed bytes, fixed working memory, fixed retrieval work, fixed compute, or fixed opportunity.
Bridge removal, recurrence removal, connectivity corruption, scale, and lifetime length are distinct interventions and cannot substitute for one another.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim separation is scientifically appropriate. M0 can authenticate only a frozen software instrument. M-TEXT can at most show that a registered fixed model's behavior depends causally on supplied connected text under changed goals and sequential public outcomes. Composition requires goal-dependent path changes plus masking and binding/twin interventions; informative-action evidence requires separating experiment choice, realized information, acquisition success, and later value to be reported separately. Action improvement requires comparison with the action the same model would take without the relevant memory, not merely task completion. Memory transport requires a later same-semantics text-versus-LoRA intervention with adapter-off, wrong-root, binding-swap, read-mask, capacity, byte, and work factors. Online learning requires memory to change an action, that action to change acquired evidence, a grounded write to change later memory, and the later memory to improve a subsequent action. Continued improvement requires independently raised lineages, genuinely increasing nonrepeated information, a certified evolving text baseline, prospective plateau and late-slope gates, retention, and terminal advantage. A single old-plus-new reset relay establishes none of accumulation, lifetime scaling, compression, baseline saturation, or an action–experience flywheel.

graph_delta_interpretation: The graph correctly separates an external V7 reference, a PCFL-specific M0 fixture, model-free conformance, a frozen M0-to-M-TEXT handoff, a later supplied-text assay, and independent E0/G prerequisites for LoRA. This prevents CPU software, V7 authority, supplied-text use, writer correctness, and LoRA transport from being credited to one another. It does not yet force the full organism to be useful: no node authors local DREAM edges from the agent's own experience, accumulates them across dream or life cycles, performs a grounded memory write, compares text with LoRA under a charged fixed-memory sweep, or measures increasing-lifetime behavior. M-TEXT can test whether organized supplied structure is behaviorally useful only after target-only, raw-context, RAG, native-graph, organized-memory, recurrence-off, bridge, binding, and connectivity controls are exact. The graph also needs explicit clean/session and confirmation prerequisites for claim-bearing M-TEXT execution, not only for M-LORA.

loop_delta_interpretation: The full intended organism is temporally ordered as grounded action, public outcome, target-independent local DREAM proposal or re-expression, later independent support, transactional SLEEP/LoRA memory transport, later goal release, and goal-conditioned THINK retrieval/composition/action/revision; subsequent outcomes may seed later dream cycles. Useful local edges should accumulate across multiple eligible episodes and dream cycles without precomputing every future goal path, while THINK constructs a goal-conditioned route only when demanded. The proposed M0 loop implements only deterministic preparation and fixture recurrence. M-TEXT implements sequential read–act–observe–revise behavior over externally supplied text, with one old-plus-new reset relay, but no DREAM authorship, grounded memory writer, parametric update, or multi-cycle accumulation. Consequently it can test representation utility and bounded behavioral composition, but temporal separation is incomplete unless reset destroys raw context and session state and the newly observed fact crosses the reset through one explicitly identified memory channel.
system_thesis_interpretation: Dream–LoRA–Think is intended as a recurrent organism: its own actions create public grounded outcomes; target-independent DREAM operations propose local connections and re-expressions; later independent evidence validates them; SLEEP transactionally transports only supported personal semantics; and THINK retrieves and composes a goal-specific path only when a later goal demands it, then acts, observes, revises, and contributes new eligible experience. Scientific support therefore requires separate evidence for local connection discovery, accumulation across dreams or lives, memory transport, goal-conditioned composition, action improvement, online feedback, and continued improvement. M0 supplies none of those behaviors. M-TEXT-SUPPLIED can test only whether externally supplied grounded connected text is causally useful to one fixed model in a bounded relay. Even a decisive M-TEXT result would validate one representation/use link in the organism, not the organism itself.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The M0 matrix draws an appropriate firewall: private worlds, intervention oracles, V7 objects, receipts, branch ephemera, and organism-private state are unavailable to the actor; public evidence, released goals, and the supplied carrier cross only named projections; carrier construction must precede goals; and model outputs have no upstream path. This is sufficient as a semantic target only if paired-world equality covers the entire actor-visible history and all post-separation divergence is outcome-tainted. It is not yet a complete model-facing visibility contract. M-TEXT must additionally enumerate rendered prompt bytes, tokenizer outputs, raw chat history, KV/session/cache state, RAG indexes, query text, tool logs, parser errors, response lengths, timing, filenames, environment variables, and provider-side state. Root or manifest identities must not encode the arm or answer. Offline truth must remain checker/reporting-only. Any query agenda, reader ordering, padding, catalog, or retrieval result influenced by a future goal, hidden world, intervention label, or score would permit the intended dream-memory-think path to be bypassed.
